header.title: Statistic Card
header.description: Card that shows a metric: title, value, optional trend and an icon. Numbers are grouped and rounded for you. Group several with `StatisticCard.Group`.

users.title: Active users
users.description: Signed in during the last 24 hours

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props to see the card and the code.

texts.title: Active users
texts.description: Signed in during the last 24 hours

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: `title` and `value` are the essentials. `suffix` adds a unit, `icon` an icon in a tinted well and `trend` the trend row with an arrow. Include the sign in `trendValue`: the arrow is decorative.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: `prefix` goes before the value and `precision` sets the decimals. `groupSeparator` and `decimalSeparator` adapt the format to the language: they default to `,` and `.`.

trend.title: Trend
trend.description: `trend="up"` is green, `"down"` red and `"neutral"` gray. The trend color is independent of `tone`, which only changes the icon well.

bounce.title: Bounce rate
bounce.description: Sessions that left on the first page

invert.title: Inverted trend
invert.description: `trendInvert` paints a drop green and a rise red. Use it for metrics where going down is good, like errors or churn.

texts.title: Open incidents
texts.description: A drop is healthy for this metric

inline.title: Inline layout
inline.description: `layout="inline"` puts the icon beside the value instead of above it.

loading.title: Loading
loading.description: `isLoading` replaces the value, trend and description with animated placeholders and adds `aria-busy`. The title and icon stay. Try reloading.

footer.title: With footer
footer.description: `children` (or `footer`) adds content below the metric, like a progress bar. `extra` goes at the end of the title: if it's an icon button, give it an `aria-label`.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` accepts `sm`, `md` (default) and `lg`. It changes the padding, icon size and value typography.

tones.title: Tones
tones.description: `tone` changes the icon well color. It doesn't affect the trend or the value.

format.title: Number format
format.description: With a numeric `value`, the card groups thousands and applies `precision`. For richer formats, like currency or compact notation, pass `formatValue` with `Intl.NumberFormat`.

group.title: Group
group.description: `StatisticCard.Group` lays cards out in a grid. Without `columns`, columns fit the available width; with `columns`, they're fixed and collapse to one below 40rem.

divided.title: Divided group
divided.description: `divided` joins the cards into one surface with lines between them. It ignores `columns`. Use `bordered={false}` on each card.

custom.title: Custom color and radius
custom.description: `tone="custom"` with `color` paints the icon well with any CSS color. `rounded` adds more rounding: `true` uses the 2xl token, a number is read as a percent and a string as CSS.

header.title: Statistic Card API
header.description: API reference for the React StatisticCard: card and group props, helpers, CSS classes, variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath. `StatisticCard.Group` is also exported as `StatisticCardGroup`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: StatisticCard accepts <article> attributes except title, which is the metric name here. They go to the root along with ref. style is merged with --gem-statistic-card-radius and --gem-statistic-card-color. StatisticCard.Group accepts <div> attributes.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.semantics: Each card is an <article> with aria-labelledby pointing to the title. Without a title, pass aria-label.
a11y.heading: A text title renders as an <h3>; if you pass a node, it's a div. The value is a <p>, not a heading.
a11y.trend: The trend arrow has aria-hidden. The component adds an English aria-label ("Increase", "Decrease") on a <p>, which many screen readers ignore. Put the direction in the visible text: a sign in trendValue ("+12%") or a word in trendLabel.
a11y.color: Green and red alone don't tell whether something improved, especially with trendInvert. Add context in description.
a11y.icon: The icon well has aria-hidden: it's decorative.
a11y.loading: With isLoading the card gets aria-busy="true" and the placeholders have aria-hidden. The animation stops with prefers-reduced-motion.
a11y.extra: Icon buttons in extra need an aria-label. A ProgressBar in the footer needs a name too.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: Root `<article>`. Defines the variables. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`.
rules.size: Size: `--sm`, `--md` or `--lg`. Defines padding, gap and icon size.
rules.tone: Tone: `--tone-primary` … `--tone-neutral` or `--tone-custom`. Defines the icon colors.
rules.rounded: Applied with `rounded={true}`. With a number or string, `--rounded-custom` is applied.
rules.bordered: Applied with `bordered`. Without a border, `--borderless` is applied.
rules.title: Title. Receives `classNames.title`.
rules.body: Container of the icon and content. Receives `classNames.body`.
rules.main: Column with value, trend and description. Receives `classNames.main`.
rules.valueRow: Row with prefix, value and suffix. Receives `classNames.value`.
rules.groupDivided: Applied with `divided`. One surface with lines between cards.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: StatisticCard's own variables. The size and tone classes define them, so override them with `.gem-statistic-card.your-class`.

items.--gem-statistic-card-gap: Gap between header, body and footer.
items.--gem-statistic-card-radius: Radius with a numeric or string `rounded`.

items.--gem-color-fg-muted: Title, affixes, description and neutral trend.
items.--gem-color-border: Border and lines of the divided group.
items.--gem-color-{tone}-{100|700}: Icon well for primary, secondary and tertiary.
items.--gem-color-{success|warning|error|info}: Icon well for those tones. `success-text` and `error-text` also paint the trend.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: The card also accepts `<article>` attributes (see Inheritance).

items.title: Metric name. A string renders as an `<h3>`.
items.value: Primary value. Numbers are grouped and can be rounded.
items.suffix: Node after the value, like `%` or `ms`.
items.precision: Decimals when `value` is a number. When unset, integers stay whole and decimals stay as they are.
items.extra: Content at the end of the title, like a menu or link.
items.trend: Direction of change. Drives the color and arrow. When unset, there's no trend row.
items.trendValue: Delta next to the arrow. A number is formatted like `value`.
items.color: CSS accent color. Takes priority over `tone`.
items.rounded: `true` uses the 2xl token, a number is a percent and a string is CSS.

items.columns: Number of columns, from 1 to 12. When unset, the grid fits itself.
items.divided: Joins the cards into one surface with lines between them. Ignores `columns`.

helpers.title: Helpers
helpers.description: Exported functions the card uses to format values.

items.formatStatisticValue: Formats a number with separators and precision. Returns an empty string if it isn't finite.
items.resolveDisplayedValue: Returns what the card shows: applies `formatValue` or `formatStatisticValue` to numbers and leaves other values as they are.
